description: Change a check's settings — URL, period, alias, string match, recipients, headers, locations — or pause/resume it (enabled) or mute its alerts (mute_until). Only the fields you pass are changed. Caution: URLs returned by a read-only key hide basic-auth credentials; re-sending such a URL erases them. Requires the read/write API key. updown: PUT /api/checks/:token.

custom_headers.description: HTTP headers updown sends with each request, e.g. { "X-Api-Key": "..." }.

disabled_locations.description: Monitoring locations to disable: lan, mia, tor, rbx, fra, cap, hel, sin, tok, syd.

enabled.description: Whether the check runs. false pauses it (reversible).

http_body.description: HTTP body sent with the request.

http_verb.description: HTTP verb for the request (default GET/HEAD).

mute_until.description: Mute notifications until a time (ISO8601, e.g. 2026-10-01T08:00:00Z), or 'recovery', or 'forever'.

period.description: Interval in seconds. Regular checks: 15, 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 1800 or 3600 (default 60). Pulse checks: anywhere from 15 s to 1 month.

published.description: Whether the check's public status page is visible (default false).

recipients.description: Alert recipient ids to select, e.g. ['email:12345', 'sms:67890'] (from updown_list_recipients).

string_match.description: Text that must appear in the response. For TCP/TCPS checks, '<closed>' inverts the check (alert if the port is open).

token.description: The check's unique token, e.g. ngg8 (from updown_list_checks).

url.description: New URL to monitor (not for pulse checks).

name: updown_update_check
title: Update a check
